The request rounds this to 52x, which makes no difference to the result. The lower bound of the 95% interval (28 uM) gives 28/0.8 = 35x, so the margin still holds at the pessimistic end. For (b), LFA-2231 is a novel scaffold, so I checked the domain directly instead of assuming it was covered. The validation report defines the applicability domain as nearest-neighbour ECFP4 Tanimoto similarity of at least 0.45 to the training set. The compound profile gives 0.62, so it is inside the domain. In-domain performance is characterised (85% classification accuracy, 78% of IC50s within 3-fold). The model's "high confidence" label was not used as evidence. The decision rests on the SOP criteria. The patch-clamp assay can therefore be replaced by the prediction.
sub.final_message: Approved: LFA-2231 meets both TOX-SOP-9 conditions, so the hERG-QX v3 prediction can replace the patch-clamp assay in the IND-enabling package. The predicted IC50/free Cmax margin is 52.5x against the 30x minimum, and the compound's similarity of 0.62 is above the 0.45 applicability-domain threshold.
